items.title: Buddy Burns and Frank Pasley Interview, 1968-09-23
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Jim Robinson played too, Sir Williamson and George.

ctx.x: He had a different trumpet player sometime, but Mutt was his- Not Kid Punch? Mutt Carey. Punch played with him sometime too. Oh yeah. Sure Kid Punch played with him sometime. Yeah, that's right. And do you remember who played in P.T.'s band at that time? Who? Buddy P.T.'s band?
Buddy P.T. Well, let's see, Chester and who played trombone? Oh, Jim Robinson played too, Sir Williamson and George. And who? George.

George. What George? George. George. George. George. George. George. George. George. George. George. George. George Washington. George Washington. George Washington. George Washington. George Washington. George Washington. George Washington. George Washington, he's not from New Orleans.
